title: Rule 7 independent oracle does not require boundary cases or valid-case mode fields
description: test_protocol_vector_security.py accepts any >=12 Rule7 address vectors and only validates encoding fields when present. The corpus can silently lose the newly required scope-0/scope-14 or mixed fe90/fe80 cases, and a valid case can omit one/both shared-mode encoding expectations while the oracle stays green. Require the named security boundary set and require both encoding fields on every valid case before checking the one shared AddressMode.
